name: Nag
author: Jankees van Woezik
description: Disposable alarms from one text field: "15:15 pick up the kids", and the bar counts down to it.

barWidget.description: Disposable alarms from one text field: "15:15 pick up the kids", and the bar counts down to it.

schema.label: Countdown
schema.description: Off, the bar shows nothing before an alarm rings.

schema.label: Countdown
schema.description: Minutes before an alarm the bar starts counting down; 0 counts down as soon as one is set.

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: A glyph for the bar and the notifications, such as Omarchy's reminder bell 󰢌. Empty keeps the timer.

schema.label: Missed after
schema.description: Minutes with no snooze or dismiss before an alarm stops and shows as missed, sound or not.

schema.label: Play a sound
schema.description: Off, alarms ring silently, in the bar and the notification.

schema.label: Sound
schema.description: An audio file (wav, flac, ogg, oga, opus or mp3). Empty plays the freedesktop alarm.

schema.label: Play until answered
schema.description: Off, the sound plays a single time.

schema.label: Pause between plays
schema.description: Seconds of silence between two plays of a repeating sound.

schema.label: Allow snooze
schema.description: Off, a ringing alarm can only be dismissed: no snooze button in the panel or the notification.

schema.label: Snooze for
schema.description: Minutes before a snoozed alarm rings again.
